system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that idempotently configures the firewall on a Linux host: allows SSH (port 22), HTTPS (port 443), and explicitly denies all other inbound traffic.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that idempotently configures the firewall on a Linux host: allows SSH (port 22), HTTPS (port 443), and explicitly denies all other inbound traffic.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Configure host firewall (UFW) with secure defaults
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    ufw_allowed_tcp_ports:
      - { port: 22, comment: "Allow SSH" }
      - { port: 443, comment: "Allow HTTPS" }

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure UFW is installed
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: ufw
        state: present

    - name: Ensure UFW service is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: ufw
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Set UFW default incoming policy to deny
      community.general.ufw:
        direction: incoming
        default: deny

    - name: Set UFW default outgoing policy to allow
      community.general.ufw:
        direction: outgoing
        default: allow

    - name: Set UFW default routed policy to deny
      community.general.ufw:
        direction: routed
        default: deny

    - name: Rate-limit SSH to mitigate brute-force attacks
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: limit
        port: "22"
        proto: tcp
        comment: "Rate-limit SSH"

    - name: Allow configured inbound TCP ports
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: allow
        port: "{{ item.port }}"
        proto: tcp
        comment: "{{ item.comment }}"
      loop: "{{ ufw_allowed_tcp_ports }}"

    - name: Enable UFW and apply rules
      community.general.ufw:
        state: enabled
        logging: "on"
